name: motionu-portal
description: Motion-U Portals — card-based member portal (Next.js client + FastAPI server)

scripts.start: npm --prefix client install && cd server && uv sync && uv run python -m alembic upgrade head && uv run python -m app.seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "cd server && uv run python -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.seed: cd server && uv run python -m app.seed
scripts.migrate: cd server && uv run python -m alembic upgrade head
